englishTranslation: Fine rice vermicelli sheets with roasted pork
atAGlance: Bánh hỏi heo quay is fine woven rice noodles with roast pork, usually with crackling heo quay, scallion oil, herbs, and fish sauce.
whatItIs: Bánh hỏi heo quay pairs fine woven rice-noodle sheets with roast pork and crackling, scallion oil, herbs, and nước chấm. The joy is delicate noodles against crisp pork skin.
howToEnjoy: Build small bites with bánh hỏi, roast pork, herbs, and rice paper if served, then dip lightly in nước chấm. Keep the crackling dry enough to stay crisp.
howLocalsOrder: Order bánh hỏi heo quay for a shareable plate of crackling pork and fine noodle sheets. Ask for extra rice paper or herbs if you want to eat it the local wrap-and-dip way.
worthKnowing: This is the richer cousin of grilled-pork bánh hỏi, often chosen for parties or family tables because the pork skin brings crunch.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần bánh hỏi heo quay.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of fine rice vermicelli sheets with roasted pork.
